Town of Hollis
Schedule of Fees and Charges
Re-Inspection Sitework Fee (charged for each reinspection of a non-compliant inspection)  Hourly  Hourly
Missed Inspection Fee (charged for each required inspection missed)  $100.00  $200.00
Removal of Stop Work Order  $100.00  $200.00
Refund Policy (in writing, no work started, within 30 days of issue)  Fee Paid Less $200  Fee Paid Less $300
Permits
Shall be deemed abandoned 180 days after the date of filing unless such application has been pursued in good faith or a permit has been issued.
Shall become invalid if no work has commenced within 180 days after its issuance or if more than 180 days between inspections.
Require a new approval for any modifications to the approved plans, additional permit fees will apply.
Refunds
Written request shall be provided for within 30 days of the issuance of the permit and no work shall have started.
The full amount of the fee paid less $200.00 for Residential and less $300.00 for Other Than Residential.
Refunds will be sent to the party that paid the fees.
Fee Schedule Last Approved by Select Board 07.13.2026
